description: 4-Layer Memory System (L0-L3) - Upgrade from 3-temperature store to intelligent 4-layer memory with rule-based fact extraction, Jaccard deduplication, and L2->L3 promotion logic.
steps: Create src/nexus/memory/layered.py with: MemoryLayer enum (L0_EPHEMERAL, L1_SESSION, L2_AGENT, L3_SHARED), LayeredMemoryConfig dataclass (l1_ring_size: int = 50, l2_max_facts: int = 500, l3_promotion_threshold: int = 3, dedup_similarity: float = 0.8). Fact dataclass (content: str, source_agent_id: UUID | None, created_at: datetime, access_count: int = 0, metadata: dict | None = None). L1Summary dataclass (summary: str, task_id: UUID, created_at: datetime). LayeredMemoryStore class with: L0 is caller-managed (no storage in this class, just documented). L1: ring buffer of session summaries (list with max size, oldest evicted). L2: per-agent fact store (dict[UUID, list[Fact]]) with dedup on insert. L3: shared organizational knowledge (list[Fact] accessible by all agents, promoted from L2). Methods: add_session_summary(task_id, summary) -> stores in L1 ring buffer; store_fact(agent_id, content, metadata) -> stores in L2 with dedup check; get_agent_facts(agent_id, limit) -> retrieves from L2; get_shared_knowledge(limit) -> retrieves from L3; promote_to_shared(agent_id, fact_content) -> moves fact from L2 to L3 if promotion criteria met; get_context_window(agent_id, limit) -> combines L1 + L2 + L3 for agent context.

Create src/nexus/memory/extract.py with: ExtractionRule dataclass (pattern: str, fact_type: str, transform: Callable | None). FactExtractor class that uses regex-based rules to extract facts from agent output text. Rules include: (1) 'learned that...' pattern, (2) 'important:...' pattern, (3) 'note:...' pattern, (4) 'always...' / 'never...' pattern for behavioral rules, (5) error patterns for defensive rules. Method: extract_facts(text: str, agent_id: UUID) -> list[Fact]. Include default_rules() class method returning standard rule set.

Create src/nexus/memory/dedup.py with: jaccard_similarity(set_a: set[str], set_b: set[str]) -> float function. tokenize(text: str) -> set[str] function (lowercase, split on whitespace/punctuation, filter stopwords). is_duplicate(existing_facts: list[Fact], new_fact: Fact, threshold: float = 0.8) -> bool. find_duplicates(facts: list[Fact], threshold: float = 0.8) -> list[tuple[int, int]] returning pairs of duplicate indices.

Create src/nexus/memory/promotion.py with: PromotionCriteria dataclass (min_access_count: int = 3, min_agents_referenced: int = 2, min_age_hours: int = 24). PromotionEngine class that decides whether an L2 fact should be promoted to L3. Method: should_promote(fact: Fact, criteria: PromotionCriteria, all_agent_facts: dict[UUID, list[Fact]]) -> bool. Logic: fact is promoted if (1) accessed >= min_access_count times, OR (2) the same/similar fact exists in >= min_agents_referenced different agents' L2 stores (cross-agent validation). Include promote_eligible(all_agent_facts, criteria) -> list[Fact] that scans all agents and returns facts ready for promotion.

Add tests in tests/test_layered_memory.py covering: L1 ring buffer eviction, L2 fact storage with dedup, L3 promotion from L2, get_context_window combines layers, fact extraction from text patterns, Jaccard similarity calculation, duplicate detection, promotion criteria evaluation, cross-agent fact promotion.
acceptance_criteria: LayeredMemoryStore maintains L1 ring buffer with configurable size and proper eviction
L2 facts are deduplicated using Jaccard similarity before storage
Facts can be promoted from L2 to L3 based on access count or cross-agent validation
FactExtractor extracts structured facts from free-text agent output
Jaccard dedup correctly identifies near-duplicate facts
get_context_window returns combined context from L1 + L2 + L3
All new tests pass alongside the existing 749 tests
findings: All 60 new tests pass. Full suite at 888 tests (749 baseline + 41 FEAT-001 + 38 FEAT-002 + 60 FEAT-003). The tokenize function in dedup.py filters common English stopwords but keeps single-char tokens that are meaningful (numbers like '5', '8'). Jaccard similarity threshold of 0.8 requires near-subset relationships between token sets to trigger dedup (at least 5 shared tokens with at most 1 unique to achieve 0.83). The dedup module's tokenize function is separate from retriever.py's tokenize (which returns a list and does not filter stopwords) - both are imported at different levels. The __init__.py re-exports 'tokenize' from retriever.py (existing behavior preserved).
